quota_name: Channels
description: This quota applies to channels used for CloudTrail Lake integrations with event sources outside of AWS, and does not apply to service-linked channels.

quota_name: CloudTrail file size sent to Amazon S3
description: For both management and data events, CloudTrail sends events to S3 in maximum 50 MB (compressed) ZIP files. If enabled on the trail, log delivery notifications are sent by Amazon SNS after CloudTrail sends ZIP files to S3.

quota_name: Concurrent dashboard refreshes
description: The maximum number of ongoing refreshes per dashboard.

quota_name: Concurrent queries
description: The maximum number of queued or running queries that you can run simultaneously in CloudTrail Lake.

quota_name: Conditions across all advanced event selectors
description: If a trail uses advanced event selectors, a maximum of 500 total values for all conditions in all advanced event selectors is allowed. Unless a trail logs data events on all resources, such as all S3 buckets, a trail is limited to 250 data resources. Data resources can be distributed across event selectors, but the total cannot exceed 250.

quota_name: Custom Dashboards per region
description: The maximum number of custom dashboards per region.

quota_name: Data resources across all event selectors in a trail
description: If you choose to limit data events by using event selectors or advanced event selectors, the total number of data resources cannot exceed 250 across all event selectors in a trail.

quota_name: Event data stores
description: The maximum number of event data stores per region. This includes single-Region event data stores for the Region, multi-Region event data stores across all AWS Regions, and organization event data stores. In shadow regions, to get the latest resource count metric, call the ListEventDataStores API.

quota_name: Event selectors
description: The maximum number of event selectors per trail.

quota_name: Event size
description: The maximum event size (in KB). All event versions: events over 256 KB cannot be sent to CloudWatch Logs. Event version 1.05 and newer: maximum event size of 256 KB.

quota_name: Events per PutAuditEvents request
description: You can add up to 100 activity events (or up to 1 MB) per PutAuditEvents request.

quota_name: Summarized query results size
description: The maximum size (in MB) of query results that can be summarized in a month

quota_name: Trails per region
description: The maximum number of trails per region. In shadow regions, to get the latest resource count metric, call the ListTrails API.

quota_name: Transactions per minute (TPM) for the GenerateQuery API
description: The maximum number of operation requests you can make per minute without being throttled.
